claims: Matthew Perry died on October 28, 2023, at the age of 54.
Matthew Perry was best known for his role as Chandler Bing on Friends.
Matthew Perry was found unresponsive in the pool of his Pacific Palisades home.
Matthew Perry was pronounced dead at the scene.
An autopsy report released in December 2023 determined that Matthew Perry died from the acute effects of ketamine.
An autopsy report released in December 2023 determined that contributing factors to Matthew Perry's death were drowning, coronary artery disease, and buprenorphine.
Matthew Perry had been undergoing legal ketamine infusion therapy for anxiety and depression.
Five people were charged in August 2024 in connection with supplying the lethal doses of ketamine to Matthew Perry.
All five individuals entered guilty pleas.
Jasveen Sangha is known as "The Ketamine Queen".
Jasveen Sangha was identified as the dealer who supplied the ketamine to Matthew Perry.
Jasveen Sangha was sentenced on April 8, 2026, to 15 years in federal prison.
Dr. Salvador Plasencia is known as "Dr. P".
Dr. Salvador Plasencia sold ketamine to Matthew Perry in the weeks before his death.
Dr. Salvador Plasencia was sentenced in December 2025 to 30 months in prison.
Kenneth Iwamasa was Matthew Perry's live-in assistant.
Kenneth Iwamasa injected Matthew Perry with the lethal doses of ketamine.
Kenneth Iwamasa pleaded guilty.
Kenneth Iwamasa is awaiting sentencing.
Erik Fleming was an intermediary who sold the ketamine to Kenneth Iwamasa.
Erik Fleming is scheduled to be sentenced in June 2026.
Dr. Mark Chavez was a physician who sold ketamine to Dr. Salvador Plasencia.
Dr. Mark Chavez was sentenced in December 2025 to eight months of home detention and three years of supervised release.
Matthew Perry wrote about his struggles with drug and alcohol addiction in his 2022 memoir "Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing".
The Matthew Perry Foundation was established following Matthew Perry's death.
